notes: Modified cash basis; all funds treated as governmental because the report presents one Governmental Activities column (including School Nutrition and Activities funds; no proprietary statements). Receipts and disbursements are taken from the Statement of Activities (p2), which excludes interfund transfers, so beginning 2,293,970.77 + receipts 4,819,432.85 - disbursements 5,276,934.63 = ending 1,836,468.99 reconciles exactly. The budget-comparison statement (p5) prints total receipts 4,989,594.64 and disbursements 5,447,096.42, each including 170,161.79 of transfers among funds (GF 30,161.79 from QCPU close-out received; GF paid 80,000 to nutrition and 60,000 to activities). Top-level transfers are therefore null; detail lines carry the fund-level transfers as other financing. Re-check of the 472,271.88 gap: confirmed printed-report discrepancy. The General Fund operating-expense schedule (pp14-19) prints department totals that tie to total disbursements 4,727,463.67, but several departments list fewer lines than their totals (pupils 92,983.82; staff 386.98; board 3,392.12; executive administration 4,463.86; principal 26,437.43; central services 12,213.08; operation of plant 205,658.57; maintenance of plant 118,416.82; regular transportation 8,319.20 = 472,271.88). Detail double counting avoided: the General Fund receipts schedule (p6) and the object-level disbursement schedule (pp14-19) were recorded; the program-level General Fund disbursement schedule (p7) and fund summary (p5) were not. Activities fund recorded account by account from p20 (accounts with no 2025 activity omitted; receipts/disbursements/General Fund support columns); the one-line activities budget schedule (p10) not recorded; 2024 comparative schedule (p21) ignored. Zero-activity lines omitted. Mappings of function for federal and state program disbursements are assumptions (instruction). The 0.09 amount in executive administration appears on the 643 row. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (no liabilities printed). v7 re-trim added pp3-4 (Statement of Fund Balances and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds, original report pp9-10). It confirms the figures already recorded: Total Governmental Funds receipts 4,819,432.85 and disbursements 5,276,934.63, transfers 170,161.79 eliminated in its Reclassification column (so top-level transfers stay null), beginning 2,293,970.77, ending 1,836,468.99, cash 1,403,496.67 + county treasurer 432,972.32; receipt/disbursement lines kept from the Statement of Activities (p2), which categorizes them more finely; nothing added. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
